# **About the Working Group**

The purpose of the Working Group on Survey Sampling and Official Statistics (SSOS) at ISI is to take demand driven Government projects. It will work as a support group for fulfilling the mandate of the Sampling and Official Statistics Unit (SOSU) to promote research and training in Survey Sampling and Official Statistics.   It constitutes a larger pool of ISI Faculty members and its activities in the SSOS area are recognized as ISI work, without boundaries of division/centres coming in the way. If any project is taken by some members of the group, the existing rules and modalities will apply.
